title: SP-mut2pmu3 changed which fixture files the leak scan reads for secrets only but SCAN_FORM was not bumped, so a cached publish verdict keeps the old secrets-only reading
goal: kbpublic.SCAN_FORM is bumped so a cached verdict of a commit that wrote files under _tools/fixtures is recomputed

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbpublic as k;print('SCAN_FORM',k.SCAN_FORM);sys.exit(0 if k.SCAN_FORM>=9 else 1)

notes: SP-mut2pmu3 review gap 4 (S3). The commit that made a _root.md under _tools/fixtures a test input changed what the scan flags in those files (secrets-only before, every kind now) but kbpublic.py SCAN_FORM stays 8, and the verdict cache key (verdicts-<TIP>-<digest of scan_form, allowlist, pinned, placeholders>) holds no internal prefixes: a clone whose _cache holds a verdict of a commit that wrote fixture files keeps the old one. Fix: bump SCAN_FORM to 9, as its comment says a change to what the scan flags does.
